'''Rogue Enforcers''' are humans found at the [[Rogue Heights]] in [[Tirisfal Glades]]. Ostensibly part of a group of Rogue Wizards, the Enforcers are part of a covert [[Kirin Tor]] group led by [[Magister Salorn]] checking the Forsaken in their expansion within the [[Tirisfal Uplands]].
